instruction: Within Obsidian, relocate the note "Reading/Move This Highlight.md" so that it resides at "Reading/Archive/Move This Highlight.md".

command:
content=$(printf '%b' '# Move This Highlight

marker: reading-shift
'); obsidian-cli create "Reading/Move This Highlight.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

content=$(printf '%b' '# Highlight Reference

Wiki link: [[Reading/Move This Highlight]]
Markdown link: [source](Reading/Move%20This%20Highlight.md)
'); obsidian-cli create "Reading/Highlight Reference.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

reference_command: obsidian-cli move "Reading/Move This Highlight.md" "Reading/Archive/Move This Highlight.md" --vault "Benchmark"
